brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel provided British intelligence about an incident Sunday near RAF Fairford, a military base in England, without offering evidence to support the claim, Middle East Eye reported. The Israeli prime minister did not specify what warning Israel had allegedly given or what form the intelligence took.

The statement came after an unidentified object was spotted near the RAF facility, which hosts American B-52 bombers. Details of the incident and any Israeli forewarning remain unconfirmed.
dek: RAF Fairford: Netanyahu claims Israel warned UK of ‘Iranian attack’ Benjamin Netanyahu has claimed Israel gave Britain intelligence about the incident last Sunday near the RAF Fairford military base, without providing any evidence.
title: Netanyahu claims Israel warned Britain of Iranian attack near RAF base
